text:
Alex Chen: Hey support, hitting 403s when switching project context with a service-account token. Repro steps below, seems like role binding is visible in console but API calls error. Root message ts=1990012345
Mia Patel: Thanks Alex — can you paste the exact curl you used and the full 403 body?
Alex Chen: Sure. Minimal repro (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ya29.SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/proj-42/models
```
Response: 403 Forbidden
```
{"error":{"code":403,"message":"permission denied: projects.get_model","details":[]}}
```
Alex Chen: Console shows me as Project Admin (Projects > proj-42 > Roles shows Project Admin). I can see the role in the UI and the bindings include the service account. But any API call under that project ID returns 403.
Gaurav Singh: Interesting — is this happening only for service-account tokens or for user tokens too?
Alex Chen: Only service-account tokens. I impersonated the same user via OIDC and user token works fine.
Mia Patel: Any recent org changes? org transfer / merge / SCIM sync? Could be a stale inheritance entry.
Alex Chen: We migrated some projects between orgs last week (org split for billing). We did a role remap script. I suspect inheritance flags might be wrong.
Sarah Ortiz: @Alex can you check the token scopes? service account tokens issued via our internal service sometimes omit the `project_access` claim if created before the org move.
Alex Chen: Good call. Token JWT payload snippet (decoded):
```
{
  "iss": "https://auth.redwood.example/",
  "sub": "service-account:sa-123",
  "aud": "redwood-api",
  "iat": 1680000000,
  "exp": 1680003600,
  "scopes": ["read:models"],
  "projects": ["proj-42"]
}
```
Alex Chen: scopes list doesn't include `project_admin` but console still shows binding.
Mia Patel: Ok that suggests the service that mints tokens didn't pick up the new role claim. Two lines of debugging: 1) ask auth-service logs for token mint times and role claim resolution; 2) check the role-sync job that populates the service account roles in the claims cache.
Support Bot: Created ticket INC-5421 and linked to this thread.
Gaurav Singh: For immediate workaround, can you test creating a fresh service-token via the console 'Create key' flow (which calls the new token-mint API) and see if that token contains the expected claims? If yes, rotate keys for affected SA.
Alex Chen: I created a new key, token now shows `project_admin` in scopes and the same curl returns 200. So rotation fixes it.
Sarah Ortiz: OK that narrows scope — mint-time claim resolution bug. Mia — can we check the cache invalidation logic for role mappings after org-project transfers? Specifically the background job `role-mapper-sync` (k8s cron: role-mapper-sync:0 */6 * * *).
Mia Patel: Will do. Also need logs from `auth-mint` around 1699999990-1699999999 for SA `sa-123` to see if it hit a cache miss and skipped enrichment.
Alex Chen: Posting the support logs I grabbed: `auth-mint` shows `WARN: role-claim-missing for sa-123; fallback to minimal-scopes` at 1699999987.
Gaurav Singh: That matches. Likely the role-sync didn't pick up the project mapping post-migration. Root cause path looks like: org move -> role-sync job hasn't re-run -> old entries left in role-claim-cache -> auth-mint mints tokens with stale/empty claims -> console UI still reads authoritative role bindings (from DB) but token claims are stale -> API enforces claims -> 403.
Mia Patel: Proposed fix: 1) force role-mapper-sync run for affected org (manual k8s job run), 2) add a short-term backfill to rebuild claims for service accounts modified in the migration window, 3) in `auth-mint` add a fallback to query authoritative role DB if claim enrichment fails (to avoid silent fallback to minimal scopes).
Sarah Ortiz: Ops should run manual sync and rotate SA keys for customers who report issues. Also add a monitoring alert for `role-claim-missing` to catch regressions.
Alex Chen: Can we notify the customer? This was a paying enterprise on Dedicated. They saw broken CI pipelines.
Mia Patel: I'll open an incident notification to the account manager and propose the workaround (rotate SA keys + we run manual sync).
Support Bot: Notified account-ops for INC-5421.
Gaurav Singh: Assigning to eng-infra to add fallback in auth-mint and to eng-ml infra for role-mapper reliability.
Alex Chen: Thanks all. I'll rotate impacted keys and confirm with the customer after ops runs the sync.
Mia Patel: Followup actions: `role-mapper-sync --run-manual org=org-884`, backfill script `scripts/backfill-sa-claims --org org-884 --since 1699900000`, add alert `auth.role_claim_missing > 5/min` in pager.
Sarah Ortiz: ETA for manual sync?
Mia Patel: Can run within one hour. Scheduling now.
Alex Chen: Confirmed after rotation + manual sync: customer's CI green. Closing loop. :tada:
